name: Anonymous Feedback
description: Students submit feedback anonymously. AI groups responses into themes — no individual answers shown to the class.
tagline: Perfect for end-of-unit reflection, course evaluations, and 'tell me how I'm doing' moments.

question.label: What do you want feedback on?
question.helper: Frame it as an open question. Students will know responses are anonymous to the class.
question.placeholder: What's one thing I could do differently to help you learn better?

timer.label: Time to respond (seconds)
timer.helper: Give students enough time to think — anonymous feedback rewards reflection.

template.name: Feedback: ${question}
template.description: An anonymous feedback collection built with the Anonymous Feedback recipe.

intro.message:
## Your responses are anonymous to the class.

Your teacher will see a summary, not who said what. Be honest!

process.instruction: You are summarizing anonymous student feedback. Group similar responses into 3-5 themes. For each theme, give it a short heading and a 1-2 sentence summary describing what students said. Do NOT quote individual responses verbatim — paraphrase to preserve anonymity. Highlight any actionable patterns the teacher could use. Keep the total response under 250 words. Use plain markdown.

end.message: Thanks for sharing — your feedback matters.
